Read a CBS file (synthetic) or any other .sav file (via haven)

Source: R/api.R
read_sav.Rd

Drop-in replacement for haven::read_sav() that intercepts registered CBS dataset file names and returns synthetic microdata. For all other file paths, falls through to haven::read_sav().

Usage

read_sav(
  file,
  encoding = NULL,
  user_na = FALSE,
  col_select = NULL,
  skip = 0L,
  n_max = Inf,
  .name_repair = "unique",
  year = 2023L,
  seed = 42L,
  ...
)

Arguments

file

File name or path. For simulated files, use the exact CBS CamelCase name (e.g. "WoonbasePopulatiePersonen2023V1").

encoding

Passed to haven::read_sav() (non-simulated files only).

user_na

Passed to haven::read_sav() (non-simulated files only).

col_select

Column selection (tidyselect expressions or character vector).

skip

Number of rows to skip (default 0).

n_max

Maximum number of rows to return (default Inf).

.name_repair

Column-name repair. For non-simulated files this is passed to haven::read_sav(). For simulated files (and parquet reads) it is applied only when it is a function (e.g. ~ make.unique(.x)); string presets like "unique" are ignored because generated names are already unique.

year

Simulation year used for auto-init (default 2023).

seed

RNG seed used for auto-init (default 42).

...

Additional arguments passed to haven::read_sav().

Value

A tibble.
